en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having been asked about a man performing Tumatto with the Umra to the Hajj, and does not happen to have a sacrificial animal with him So he Fasts the three days during the Hajj, then dies after having returned to his family, before he Fasts the seven days. Is it upon his guardian that he fulfils it on his behalf?’ Heasws said: ‘Iasws do not see a repayment to be upon him’.
en.sarwar: 13. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man for al-Hajj al-Tamattu‘ (advantageous) who did not have an animal for offering. Therefore, he fasted for three days in al-Hajj : then he died after returning to his family and before fasting the seven days: if it was obligatory on his guardian to fast on his behalf. He (the Imam) said, ‘I do not see any Qada’ (compensatory fast) obligatory on him.’”
